title: Part 3.II — Dialectic in General
role: The volume's closing theoretical chapter. Burke generalizes the dialectical apparatus implicit in the pentad and substance vocabulary into a standalone toolkit: transformation-of-terms (how pentad terms migrate between motive-statements), merger and division (the basic dialectical operations), the dialectic of the scapegoat (scapegoating as a structured merger-then-division of an agent who carries collective motives), per genus et differentiam (the classical definitional move read as a dialectical operation), the mind-body / being-nothing / action-passion paired oppositions, Socratic transcendence (the upward dialectical move), the temporizing of essence (how dialectic unfolds essential relations into temporal sequences), and a closing 'Dissolution of Drama' that gestures toward what happens to the dramatistic frame when dialectic is taken to its limit. Provides first-class dialectical apparatuses that Phase 3 must catalog as transferable instruments alongside the pentad.
